summary: Test only: the fractal-test-test time-limit tests no longer race a real 1 or 2 s --time-limit. Six checks that ran real sleeps against those limits now simulate 100 s of running, or of waiting for a build slot, against a 50 s limit, so a loaded host's time to start its commands cannot decide the outcome (#4879).

replay.detail: No stored data is read or written differently.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Tests only; st-test and ci-local are unchanged.
